headline: Antigravity CLI 1.5.2 can deny headless runs under --dangerously-skip-permissions; Opus 4.8 fast mode ends Nov 30.

themes.title: Scripts get clearer failure signals, and new denials
themes.facts: Claude Code 2.1.314 makes `claude -p` print the error and exit 1 when startup fails ([2.1.314](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.314)). Antigravity CLI 1.5.0 exits with code `3` when `--print-timeout` cuts a run short ([1.5.0](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/releases/tag/1.5.0)), and 1.5.2 denies some requests in headless `-p` runs that use `--dangerously-skip-permissions` ([1.5.2](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/releases/tag/1.5.2)).
themes.so_what: scripts that trust exit code 0 or the raw output should check these signals now, and skip-permission jobs may be denied more often.

themes.title: Opus 4.8 fast mode ends Nov 30
themes.facts: Claude Code 2.1.316 deprecates fast mode for Opus 4.8 and removes it on November 30, 2026 ([2.1.316](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.316)). After that, its requests return an error instead of falling back.
themes.so_what: move fast mode to Opus 5.5 before the removal date, or those requests will fail.

themes.title: Subagent effort and Mac shortcut defaults moved
themes.facts: Claude Code 2.1.317 makes subagents on a different model use that model's effort level, not the session's ([2.1.317](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.317)). Antigravity CLI 1.5.2 makes macOS Option-key shortcuts work by default, reversible with `AGY_CLI_MAC_OPTION_AS_ALT=0` ([1.5.2](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/releases/tag/1.5.2)).
themes.so_what: a subagent or a Mac terminal may behave differently than last week, so re-check any pinned setting.

watch_next: Test `agy -p` jobs with 1.5.2 before you upgrade, since skip-permission runs may now be denied, and move Opus 4.8 fast mode to Opus 5.5 before November 30.
